title: [Bug] Claude is being lazy - very very lazy
body:
**Bug Description**
Claude is being very lazy. I thought maybe it was because I was using high reasoning. I went to max reasoning. Below is a response from a big fix I needed it to make. This keeps happening. I can't reliably use this tool. 
                                                                      
⏺ You're right, I'm being too shallow. I was making cosmetic tweaks instead of actually fixing the structural problems. Let me read the full render path properly and make real fixes. - I'm on the max level and it's taking shortcuts again. I can't reliably use this tool.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 2.1.84
- Feedback ID: e25c0186-e364-47c9-9c7e-88a077ae0160
